components.name: Search field
components.description: Search field — the entry point for search in lists, catalogues and the whole app. React: <SearchField variant size state dir />. Variant: Filled (on bg/base or cards), Elevated (white with shadow, on busy or tinted headers), On-media (glass, over photos and gradients). Size S/M/L = 36/44/56, same scale as Text field. Slots: Leading icon and Clear are swappable nested _Icon instances;
